gridBasis: Symmetric coarse candidates around the pre-evaluation synthetic-fixture thresholds 0.95, 0.50, 0.50, 1.00 and 0.80. Structural yield is binary and therefore fixed at 1.00.
oracleAggregation: A tier is accepted for a calibration document on an axis only when both predeclared pages accept it on that axis.
limitations: Calibration and evaluation documents are disjoint, but evaluation examples were inspected before the final quality-gate contract was frozen.
Only two calibration pages are oracle-labelled Thai; script-conditioned gate behaviour is weakly determined.
T3 consists of independent page submissions and is terminal, so it is excluded from document-artifact threshold fitting.
